paper.title_en: Trapped surface formation via radial boosts
paper.abstract_en: Work of Christodoulou, Klainerman, Rodnianski, Luk, An, and others has provided a number of results on the dynamical formation of trapped surfaces in vacuum solutions to the Einstein field equations. Since the stability of Minkowski spacetime as proved by Christodoulou and Klainerman implies that `small' initial data to the Einstein vacuum equations must give rise to a solution with no singularities, and hence no trapped surfaces, it has been assumed that dynamical formation of trapped surfaces requires a (hard) large-data existence result for the nonlinear hyperbolic Einstein field equations. In this paper we show, to the contrary, that dynamical trapped surface formation results qualitatively similar to those of Christodoulou and Klainerman-Rodnianski can be obtained from (classical) local, small-data existence results via a scaling we term a radial boost. In the process we also fully elucidate the short-pulse ansatz as a geometric optics ansatz by showing that, in this scaled picture, the so-called incoming shear satisfies, at highest order, a linear wave equation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文通过引入径向加速标度，从局部小数据存在性结果推导出动力陷获面形成，对广义相对论基础有重要贡献。
decision.title_zh: 径向加速下的陷获面形成
decision.abstract_zh: Christodoulou、Klainerman、Rodnianski、Luk、An等人的工作提供了关于爱因斯坦真空场方程中陷获面动力学形成的众多结果。由于Christodoulou和Klainerman证明的闵可夫斯基时空的稳定性意味着爱因斯坦真空方程的'小'初始数据必须产生无奇异性的解，因此不存在陷获面，人们一直认为陷获面的动力学形成需要非线性双曲型爱因斯坦场方程的（困难的）大数据存在性结果。在本文中，我们证明了相反的情况：通过与称为径向加速的标度，可以从（经典的）局部的、小数据存在性结果获得与Christodoulou和Klainerman-Rodnianski定性相似的动力学陷获面形成结果。在这个过程中，我们还通过证明在这种标度图像中，所谓的入射剪切在最高阶上满足线性波动方程，充分阐明了短脉冲假设作为几何光学假设的性质。
